Documents to be submitted for First Year Admission 
Under CAP/Minority Seats/ Against CAP Vacancy 
1. CAP Admission Seat Allotment Letter from the CET Cell. (MH). 
2. FC Acknowledgement 
3. Marksheet of SSC (Std. X) examination. 
4. Marksheet of HSC (Std. XII) / Diploma in Engineering (All Semester ). 
5. College Leaving Certificate after passing HSC Exam from last attended College. 
6. MHT-CET / JEE Main Score card for current year. 
7. Migration Certificate ( in case of candidate passing qualifying exam. from any other Board 
other than Maharashtra State Board of Secondary & higher Secondary Education.) 
 
8. Certificate of DOMICILE  
9. Leaving Certificate/Birth Certificate Indicating birth place in the State of Maharashtra. 
10. Gap Certificate on stamp paper of Rs.100/- duly notarized. (This is for those candidates who 
have passed HSC /12th Standard in March 2023 or before and presently not studying in any 
course / institution.) 
11. Caste Certificate for Backward class Candidates.  
12. Caste Validity Certificate for SC/ST/VJ/DT, (NT-A), (NT-B), (NT-C), (NT-D) /OBC/SBC. 
13. Non Creamy Layer (This certificate should be valid upto 31st March 2025) for VJ/DT-NT(A), 
NT(B), NT(C), NT(D), SBC and OBC . 
14. Income certificate by Tahsildar  
 
TFWS- Candidates: 
➢ Income certificate stating that his/her Parent's Annual Income less than 8.00 Lakhs form 
all source form "the appropriate Competent Authority of Maharashtra State. 
(Compulsory) 
 
15. Minority Candidates: 
➢ Declaration of the candidate for the respective Linguistic / Religious Minority  Community 
or Leaving Certificate having information pertaining to Religion / Mother tongue. 
 
➢ Domicile Certificates of Candidate. 
 
➢ Performa O (Self Declaration as per DTE Information Boucher for Minority student)  
 
16. Physical Fitness Certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner. 
 
17. Anti-ragging Affidavit (both Parent and Candidate) fill ONLINE at: 
      www.amanmovement.org OR www.antiragging.in and registration of printout to be 
      submitted Admission Cell. (Instruction available on college website.) 
18. Aadhar Card (Xerox copy) 
 
19. Fees Section :  
➢ Fees will not be accepted in Cash / CHEQUE 
➢ The payment of fees : Fee for different categories is available on on college website. 
➢ Demand Draft or Pay order drawn in favour of : ''Shah and Anchor Kutchhi 
Engineering College''. 
 
Note: Candidate should retain sufficient attest photo copies of all the original 
 
Certificates  which they will submit during the time of admission 
 
/documents will be issued or certified from the administrative office at a 
 
later date.
